description: The balanced ternary digit of n in place, counting from 0 at the right, as -1, 0, or 1. For 5, which is "1TT", place 0 and place 1 are -1 and place 2 is 1. A place past the end is 0. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999 and place runs from 0 to 40. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ternary-digit
